content: {"praised":["Strong performances by James Purefoy and Michael Kenneth Williams.","Faithful adaptation of Joe Lansdale's books.","Dark humor and action-packed storyline.","Fresh, original tone with raunchy, violent, profane elements.","Engaging camaraderie and witty dialogue between characters."],"criticized":["Weird, sick sadomasochistic subplot involving a sex slave.","Shallow, drab storytelling with many clichés.","Uninteresting characters and dull pacing.","Dumb script that even star couldn't salvage.","Missing expected elements like choke collar and chain."]}
